name: Reaper::register_process / ProcessTeardown<P: PlatformOps>

test_list.description: Shutdown calls PlatformOps::graceful_stop once with the registered process tree and half of the graceful budget as the platform's own grace period.
StopOutcome::Killed maps to Outcome::Forced, StopOutcome::Exited to Released.
A PlatformError becomes Outcome::Failed carrying the error text.
The root PID is journaled as an unresolved orphan; a later start-up never signals it because the live opaque handle cannot survive host restart.

dependencies: polaris_sdk::registry::{PlatformOps, ProcessTree, ProcessExit, StopOutcome, PlatformError, SpawnSpec, MemoryPressure}

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: The OS seam; the production adapter retains Windows Job Objects and Unix process groups in polaris-platform-process. Seam behavior is also tested with a fake.

output_description: Handle for the registered process tree.
